fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: Swings a chain at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 4% per 100 paces run since you last used it, up to 40%. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Coffle Drag
fusions.desc: Stretches a 6-tile line of links ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 10 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Forced Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 25% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Mile-Forged Mail
fusions.desc: Each long stretch of ground you cover wraps you in links that shield you for 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
